cases.title: Normal space exhausted refuses new contacts
cases.when: The host spool has only headroom left while a tool runs
then: New secret redemptions, broker requests and tunnel connections fail with AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE

cases.title: Headroom exhausted fences the host
cases.when: The headroom is exhausted, then the spool disk fails
then: The host enters FENCED, kills non-built-in sandboxes, invalidates tokens and reports unhealthy
Consumed work remains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN unless independent complete mediation and all effects establish resolution; executor notStarted or a non-ledger label supplies no no-write proof

cases.title: A FENCED host recovers and replays
then: In-memory records replay to the spool; outcomes are resolved from ledger and broker evidence; the host accepts work again only after reporting healthy

cases.title: Outcome evidence and audit roll back together
cases.when: A writer transaction seals an attempt and derives success, then aborts
then: The prior outcome and audit page remain byte-identical and execution remains active

cases.title: Closing an attempt cannot leave unrecorded authorization
cases.when: An active attempt authorizes an effect and its terminal transaction first aborts, then commits
then: Abort retains active authority without a seal; commit seals exact membership and refuses further authorizations; membership and seal are immutable

cases.title: A mismatching approved result cannot partially apply a review
cases.when: An independent checker approves a requested state that disagrees with derived facts
then: The approval, proof, outcome and audit all roll back
